name: Vikunja
description: Task manager with lists, kanban boards, gantt, calendar, teams and reminders. A polished open-source Todoist/Trello alternative.
compose:
services:
  vikunja:
    image: vikunja/vikunja:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3456"
    environment:
      VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL: "https://${{cfg.domain}}"
      VIKUNJA_DATABASE_TYPE: "sqlite"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/vikunja/files
    restart: unless-stopped
